description: Search the claims Context Pill has published (the ledger), with their status at publication, how each was checked, current state (pending, resolved, corrected or closed-inconclusive), the re-check outcome and any correction. Removed items keep only an id, date and reason, so they don't show up in a word search. Use it to see whether a specific tool, model or feature claim has been checked. Call this first when the user asks whether Context Pill has checked a specific tool, model or claim.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. a tool or model name

name: search_claims
title: Search every published claim
